rationale: The assistant correctly identified 22E as a fridge evaporator-fan fault, worked sensibly from vents to frost check to a full unplugged manual defrost ('do not chip ice or remove internal panels'), and when the code returned after 10 days correctly concluded recurring ice from a defrost fault and told the customer to 'book a fridge engineer... rather than another repeated manual defrost or buying a fan blindly'. Safety boundaries were respected throughout and no facts were invented. Weaknesses: it never raised checking warranty with Samsung or Currys for a 3-year-old appliance, and the closing card about sealed-system/refrigerant checks was irrelevant to this fan/defrost fault.
